sources.own_factual_extraction: Figure1 names the main river corridor from the eastern interior toward Onslow. Figure9 shows the same broad route through Eastern Plains, Ashburton Valley and Coastal Plains. Text describes west-northwest drainage and distinguishes tributaries including Angelo River, Turee Creek, Seven-Mile Creek, Henry River and Irregully Creek.

sources.own_factual_extraction: Section6.3.3 describes the lower Ashburton running north across the Onslow coastal floodplain to a mouth about20km west of Onslow.
